title: Open coefficient isomorphism normalized by the open unit
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism, and $j:W\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use ordinary small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], scalar extension $S=-\otimes_A^LB$, and exact extension by zero $j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. For $M\in D(W_{\rm et},A)$ let $\iota_{\varphi,j,M}:j_{!,B}S_WM\to S_Tj_{!,A}M$ be the prescribed inverse open coefficient map of [def-pur-open-coefficient-normalizations]: the $j_{!,B}\dashv j_B^*$ transpose of $S_W(\eta_{A,M})$ followed by the inverse of the exact-pullback scalar comparison $\lambda^{\rm ex}_{\varphi,j}$ defined there. Define $\operatorname{properOpenCoefficientOpenIso}(\varphi,j,M):S_Tj_{!,A}M\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{!,B}S_WM$ as the inverse of $\iota_{\varphi,j,M}$, regarded as an isomorphism through the existing proved invertibility of this specified map. The defining inverse is thus the actual open-unit transpose, with no arbitrary endpoint isomorphism and no boundedness or coefficient-flatness assumption. The exact-pullback comparison and $\iota$ themselves are not redefined here.

def properOpenCoefficientOpenIso
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {W T : Scheme.{u}} (j : W ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A W) :
    (scalarExtension φ T).obj
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≅
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((scalarExtension φ W).obj M)
